description: Historical Basic runs use v263/v290 with multiple recorded revisions. The linked 1.0.0 engine preserves the final corrected freeze used for P28–30 and the latest P9 rerun; it is not an exact source archive of every earlier attempt. Per-problem manifests, original runs, and the transition records preserve the observed settings. Qwen was not MTP=4 throughout the earlier run.
missing_values: Unrecorded deployment revisions/settings are unknown; current server settings are not retroactively substituted.
